# SheetJS

Vendored SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 for Excel export without a runtime CDN dependency.

Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
License source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE
License: Apache-2.0, included in LICENSE.sheetjs.

Keep the version and license together when updating. The JavaScript file is the unmodified upstream distribution.
